    def is_inside(x, y, x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max):
        return x_min < x < x_max and y_min < y < y_max
    
    def is_outside(x, y, x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max):
        return x <= x_min or x >= x_max or y <= y_min or y >= y_max
    
    def intersects(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4):
        return max(min(x1, x2), min(x3, x4)) <= min(max(x1, x2), max(x3, x4)) and \
               max(min(y1, y2), min(y3, y4)) <= min(max(y1, y2), max(y3, y4))
    
    # Check if any point outside the white sheet is inside both black sheets
    for x in range(x1 + 1, x2):
        for y in range(y1 + 1, y2):
            if is_outside(x, y, x1, y1, x2, y2) and \
               is_inside(x, y, x3, y3, x4, y4) and \
               is_inside(x, y, x5, y5, x6, y6):
                return "YES"
    
    # Check if the white sheet intersects with either black sheet

       intersects(x1, y1, x2, y2, x5, y5, x6, y6):
